description: This Java class 'CommandContext' provides an object used within the batch command processing of Apache Fineract. It includes a builder pattern for instantiating the object, methods for matching and equality checks, and holds resource and method properties for defining command context in batch requests.

classes.name: CommandContext
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command context with resource and method, used to match and process batch commands.

classes.name: CommandContext.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for creating instances of CommandContext with specified resource and method.

methods.name: matcher
methods.description: Compares this CommandContext to another, returning true if the resource regex matches and the method is equal.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on resource and method for use in hash-based collections.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this CommandContext and another object based on resource and method.
